issues.title: API routes on GitHub Pages
issues.description: Client code called /api/alert, /api/report, /api/judge on GitHub Pages where API routes are removed during build
issues.rootCause: Static export removes API routes, but client code assumed they existed
issues.fix: Added deployment.ts with isGitHubPages() + apiRoutesAvailable(); use-agent-actions checks before fetch and simulates when unavailable
issues.preempt: Never add client code that calls /api/* without checking apiRoutesAvailable() first
tests: adversarial: D2 API route simulates verdict when API unavailable

issues.title: Concurrent LLM judging race condition
issues.description: Multiple judge calls could race each other for the same camera+useCase
issues.rootCause: No deduplication of in-flight judge requests
issues.preempt: Use single-flight pattern for any idempotent network call

issues.title: LLM judge had no visual evidence
issues.description: Judge received only text metadata (count, z-score) — could not actually see the scene
issues.rootCause: Snapshot data URL was not passed to /api/judge
issues.fix: Camera-view captures 256x144 JPEG crop; /api/judge uses multimodal message format with image_url
issues.preempt: Always pass visual evidence to VLM judges, not just metadata

issues.title: Identity overclaims (color histograms as identity)
issues.description: UI called color histograms 'identity' and 'Tracked Identities'
issues.rootCause: Terminology implied identity when only appearance features were used

issues.title: Person detections triggered unrelated alerts (fire, flood, graffiti)
issues.description: 'person' was in detectionClasses for fire_smoke, graffiti, slip_hazard, etc.
issues.rootCause: Use cases listed 'person' as a detection class for hazard detection
issues.fix: Removed 'person' from detectionClasses for hazard use cases; added specializedClassName
issues.preempt: A generic person detection must not be positive evidence for an unrelated hazard
tests: adversarial: hazard classes not contaminated by person

issues.title: frame_diff was z-score proxy, not actual frame differencing
issues.description: frame_diff rule type used detection-count z-score, not pixel comparison
issues.rootCause: No actual temporal pixel comparison was implemented
issues.fix: Pixel-anomaly detection now runs BEFORE agent and injects specialized detections
issues.preempt: A count z-score must not be described as frame differencing

issues.title: UseCase.actions not controlling execution
issues.description: Agent hardcoded actions by tier, ignoring useCase.actions
issues.rootCause: decide() didn't filter actions through useCase.actions
issues.fix: Agent now filters every action through allowedActions.has(name)
issues.preempt: The declared policy must be authoritative, not documentation-only

issues.title: Parking threshold zero always-true
issues.description: Parking threshold was 0, so any frame triggered an alert
issues.fix: Changed threshold 0→1; parking now requires at least 1 vehicle
issues.preempt: Test every threshold — a passive telemetry use case must not generate alerts merely because its condition is always true

issues.title: Non-functioning model adapters
issues.description: YOLOv10n, YOLOS-tiny, SegFormer, YOLOv8n-pose were selectable but had no adapters
issues.fix: Added adapterImplemented: boolean; camera-view filters by this flag; UI shows badges
issues.preempt: Never claim a model works without an adapter — mark it 'pending'

issues.title: Model ranking zero-value handling
issues.description: License ranking was case-sensitive ('apache-2.0' vs 'Apache-2.0'); builtin pixel-anomaly (size=0) ranked first
issues.rootCause: Used rank[value] || fallback which treated 0 as falsy; case mismatch in license lookup
issues.fix: Case-insensitive license matching; builtin treated as Infinity for sort
issues.preempt: Don't use rank[value] || fallback when zero is a valid rank

issues.title: Mutable unpinned model revisions
issues.description: Models loaded mutable Hub revisions — no reproducibility
issues.rootCause: No revision pinning in model registry
issues.fix: Every HF model now has a pinned revision hash
issues.preempt: No production model may load an unpinned revision

issues.title: IndexedDB vs in-memory store mismatch
issues.description: db.ts used Prisma (server-only) — didn't work on GitHub Pages
issues.rootCause: Wrong persistence layer for static export
issues.preempt: If the system is in-memory only, say so — don't claim IndexedDB persistence without implementing it

issues.title: Playwright tests bypassed UI
issues.description: Tests used window.__visionStore, direct Zustand mutation, raw DOM click dispatch
issues.rootCause: Ad-hoc scripts prioritized speed over user-level testing
issues.fix: Created formal @playwright/test suite using getByRole/getByTestId only
issues.preempt: Tests must use the visible UI — never mutate internal state directly
tests: adversarial: D13 formal Playwright suite rules

issues.title: Test hook in production
issues.description: window.__visionStore was exposed in production builds
issues.rootCause: Inline hook in store.ts was not tree-shaken
issues.fix: Moved to dev-store-hook.ts; loaded via dynamic import only when NODE_ENV !== 'production'
issues.preempt: Testing hooks must be compile-time disabled in production
tests: adversarial: D14 store.ts does NOT contain hook
playwright: production build does not expose dev store hook

issues.title: Unreproducible test counts
issues.description: No checked-in test commands — pass counts in commit messages were not evidence
issues.fix: Added test, test:pw, test:formal, test:all scripts
issues.preempt: Pass counts in commit messages are not evidence — expose checked-in commands

issues.title: Marketing-claim drift
issues.description: Claims like '~10 fps', '~60% FP reduction', 'immutable action log' were unsupported
issues.rootCause: Marketing language drifted from actual behavior
issues.fix: Replaced with honest claims: '0.3-1 fps (WASM)', 'Optional LLM judge', 'session action log (in-memory)'
issues.preempt: Every quantitative or operational claim requires reproducible evidence or must be removed
